content: चैतन्यम् [चेतनस्य भावः ष्यञ्] .²1 Spirit, life, intelligence, vitality, sensation. .²2 Soul, spirit, mind; <ls>U. 1. 36</ls>. .²3 Consciousness, feeling, sensation, sense; <ls>U. 1. 48</ls>. .²4 (In Vedānta <ab>phil.</ab>) The Supreme Spirit considered as the essence of all being and source of all sensation.
